The only way to infer this without a given structure is to examine its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for carbon atoms. Methyl carbons typically appear in the range ~10–30 ppm. By counting distinct signals in that region we can infer the number of CH₃ groups. I will request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
